title: Proxmint Free Proxy List
description:
A point-in-time snapshot of the Proxmint Free Proxy List: open HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 proxies, each re-tested with a real request routed through it. The live list is re-validated every 30 minutes at proxmint.com/free-proxies and mirrored in proxmint/free-proxy-list. Free proxies go stale within hours, so use this record to cite or study the list, and use the live API for working proxies.

Files: proxies/*.txt per protocol, proxies/all.json with country, anonymity, latency, uptime and score. The proxies are other people's infrastructure and are not claimed; the compilation (selection, validation results, measured fields) is licensed CC BY 4.0.
